battle.name: 同治陝甘回變
battle.theater: 陝西關中與甘肅河洮走廊
battle.brief: 一八六二年二月，陝西回民於華州起義，攻涇陽、臨潼並圍困西安；甘肅河州馬化龍同年響應，據洮河立寨建軍，與清廷對抗十五年。一八七六年左宗棠收復肅州，一八七七年河州歸順，首領誅於蘭州。全役在內陸，無海軍參與；同年英國首批鐵甲艦入役，漢普頓斯維之役證其長，此器只是那一代技術的標記。

kit.name: 鐵甲艦
kit.history: 木殼外面包了鐵。裝甲第一次比砲更難對付，砲塔的設計從此繞著它轉。

countries: 交戰的兩方並非兩個國家，而是大清帝國版圖內部的兩個陣營。朝廷一方是清廷的陝甘軍政體系：陝西方面有巡撫衙門組織的團練與鄉勇，甘肅方面有自陝甘、寧夏、河西調集的綠營與馬隊，中央另自湖南、湖北、吉林、黑龍江調來湘軍楚勇與滿洲騎兵。指揮系統分兩層：外省督撫管民政與糧餉，欽差大臣管兵權；一八六六年左宗棠出任陝甘總督，一八六九年多隆阿以荊州將軍兼陝甘總督，一八七三年楊岳斌再署此職。反對一方是陝甘回民起義軍，以甘肅河州（今臨夏）為發祥地與大都，馬化龍自一八六二年起兵後居最高統帥之位，軍隊按營、隊編制，以回民村寨為堡壘，兵員多為隴右的農民與教門丁壯，高層多為馬氏族內的族長與阿訇。英國與俄羅斯都不是交戰方，但同期向交戰兩方售賣軍火；沙俄並在新疆方向乘勢擴張，是這場內戰之外的外部變數。
countriesEn: The two sides in this conflict were not two countries but two camps inside the territory of the Qing Empire. On the court's side stood the Shaanxi-Gansu military administration of the Qing state: in Shaanxi, the tuanlian and village levies organised by the governor's offices; in Gansu, the green standard infantry and mounted troops transferred in from Shaanxi-Gansu, Ningxia and Hexi; and at the centre, the Xiang and Chu armies of Hunan and Hubei together with Manchu cavalry summoned from Jilin and Heilongjiang. Command was split in two layers: the provincial governors handled civil administration and pay and rations, while an imperial commissioner held the war power. Zuo Zongtang became governor-general of Shaanxi-Gansu in 1866; Dolongga held the same post as governor-general of Jingzhou in 1869; Yang Yuebin signed for it again in 1873. The other side was the Hui rising in Shaanxi and Gansu, whose birthplace and capital was Hezhou in Gansu, present-day Linxia. After raising his banner in 1862 Ma Hualong stood at the head of it as supreme commander; the troops were organised into ying and dui, used the villages of the Hui as their stockades, and were drawn from the peasantry and the religious communities of Longyou; the upper command came largely from the clan heads and religious leaders of the Ma family. Neither Britain nor Russia was a belligerent, but both were selling arms to the two sides in this period, and Russian expansion towards Xinjiang made an external variable standing beside this civil war.
people: 馬化龍是起義的靈魂人物。他出自河州回民中的教門世家，年輕時在當地主持經堂，一八六二年以教門領袖身分號召起兵，隨後被部眾尊為統帥，據河州為根本，以洮河、大夏河谷的村寨為巢，兵源隨教門網絡迅速擴張；他一面用兵，一面以宗教權威維持隊伍紀律，一八七四年在內部權力糾葛中死去，傳說是被部下所毒，隊伍由其族內後輩接手，統一局面隨之瓦解。馬文升是後來的軍事主將，馬安良、馬中勳同為河州回軍頭目，一八七七年三月率眾歸順，四月即被押至蘭州處決，餘部則被拆散編入清軍與團練。左宗棠是清方主導者，同治五年出任陝甘總督，先與捻軍周旋於直、豫、晉三省，後全力經營隴右，以先籌糧、後進兵的次序部署，一八七六年收復肅州，一八七七年收拾河州，其後奉命西征。劉松山是楚軍老將，一八七〇年攻蒲城時陣亡，其子劉錦棠接掌軍務，先後經略肅州、河州，一八七八年統軍入疆。多隆阿率滿洲馬隊入陝，戰力強於綠營，卻在一八七〇年冬陣亡於山西安邑曹店。楊岳斌與彭玉麟都是湘軍水師出身，一八六二年在安慶造出輪船、組成黃旗水師，是同年世界海軍技術浪潮中最貼近這條戰線的旁證。
peopleEn: Ma Hualong was the soul of the rising. He came from a religious family among the Hui of Hezhou, ran a prayer hall there while still young, and called the rising to arms in 1862 as a leader of his community; his followers then set him up as commander-in-chief. He made Hezhou his base and the villages of the Taohe and Daxia river valleys his nest, and his manpower grew quickly along the network of the religious communities. He fought and held the ranks together at the same time by the authority of the faith, and in 1874 he died amid the internal struggle for power, the story going that he was poisoned by his own men; the command then passed to younger members of his clan and the unity of the movement fell apart with him. Ma Wensheng was the chief military leader of the later phase, and Ma Anliang and Ma Zhongxun were fellow chiefs of the Hezhou army; they surrendered with their men in March 1877 and were taken to Lanzhou and executed in April, while the rest of the force was broken up and absorbed into the Qing army and the tuanlian. Zuo Zongtang directed the court side. He became governor-general of Shaanxi-Gansu in 1866, spent his first years chasing the Nian in Zhili, Henan and Shanxi, and then devoted himself to Longyou, ordering his operations as first the transport of grain and only then the advance; he retook Suzhou in 1876, closed out Hezhou in 1877, and was afterwards ordered west. Liu Songshan was an old commander of the Chu army, killed in 1870 while assaulting Pucheng, and his son Liu Jintang took over the command, working through Suzhou and Hezhou in turn and leading the army into Xinjiang in 1878. Dolongga brought Manchu cavalry into Shaanxi, and they were far stronger than the green standard troops, but he was killed at Caodian in Anyi, Shanxi, in the winter of 1870. Yang Yuebin and Peng Yulin both came out of the Xiang army's navy; in 1862 they built steamers at Anqing and formed the Yellow Flag fleet, and they are the closest thing to this front line in the naval technology wave of that same year.
kits: 把鐵甲艦寫進這場戰爭，先要說清它其實不在戰場上。一八六二年正是裝甲世代落地的一年：三月九日漢普頓斯維灣之戰，聯邦軍維吉尼亞號在交火當日自沉，北軍監視者號退出一線、同年十二月在海上沉沒，木殼配浮動砲塔的路線由此被否定；同年英國第一批鐵甲巡洋艦——鐵衛號、黑王子號、防禦號、抵抗號——陸續入役，海軍的砲塔設計從此繞著鐵皮轉。同一年的長江上，湘軍水師在安慶造出五艘輪船，組成黃旗水師，由彭玉麟與楊岳斌主持，那是木殼蒸汽炮船，與同年英國的鐵甲艦比起來裝甲近乎沒有，卻是中國海軍真正的開端。戰場本身在隴右內陸，沒有軍艦，沒有水師；唯一的水上力量是黃河、洮河上的羊皮筏子、牛皮筏與漕船，用途是渡河與運糧，不算作戰兵器。真正左右交鋒的是抬槍、馬槍、大刀、長矛與少量冷砲，攻城靠火藥與地道；回軍後期經中亞與俄國的渠道換到洋槍與彈藥，清軍攻堡則以銅砲、抬砲與開山砲連環射擊，再派工兵穴地爆破。
kitsEn: Putting the ironclad into this war means saying first that it was not on the battlefield at all. The year 1862 was the one in which the age of armour landed: at the action of Hampton Roads on 9 March the Confederate Virginia burned and sank on the day of the fight and the Union's Monitor was retired from the line and went down at sea in December of that same year, so that the line of wooden hulls with floating gunports was refuted; in the same year the first British armoured frigates, HMS Warrior, Black Prince, Defence and Resistance, entered service one after another, and naval turret design turned around the iron skin from then on. On the Yangtze in that same year the Xiang navy built five steamers at Anqing and formed the Yellow Flag fleet under Peng Yulin and Yang Yuebin; they were wooden-hulled steam gunboats, with no armour at all beside the British ironclads of the year, and yet they were the true beginning of the Chinese navy. The battlefield itself lay in the interior of Longyou, with no warships and no navy; the only waterborne strength was the goatskin rafts, the hide rafts and the grain junks on the Yellow River and the Taohe, used for crossing rivers and moving grain, and not weapons of war. What really shaped the fighting was the shoulder gun, the cavalry musket, the heavy sabre, the long spear and a small number of cold cast guns, with powder and tunnels for assaulting walls. The rebels later obtained foreign rifles and ammunition through channels in Central Asia and Russia, while the Qing attacked stockades with bronze guns, light pieces and mountain guns in continuous bombardment, and then sent sappers in to blow the walls from underneath.
tactics: 回軍的戰法先是堡寨加流動襲擾。兵聚在隴東、隴南的塬堡村落之中，出擊後即回村寨依託，騎隊專切清軍糧道、驛站與援兵通道，使楚軍不得不分兵護糧，無法集中。攻西安與圍肅州時，回軍以掘地道、埋火藥破城牆，肅州之圍自一八六四年起延續十二年，守軍靠井渠取水、靠屯糧撐住城頭。清軍沿用湘軍的結營進逼：每日挖壕疊牆、步步為營，砲兵以銅砲與抬砲連環射擊堡牆，再派工兵貼近穴地轟破；左宗棠到任後改以因糧進軍為主軸，先用駱駝隊、騾隊與黃河皮筏把糧運到前線，再分路進攻河州，一八七七年三月馬文升開洮河營議降，才得以集中兵力逐堡取寨。捻軍在河北、河南、山西牽制楚軍主力，陝甘戰線屢屢被抽空，這是清方最被動的一環。
tacticsEn: The method of the rebels began as stockade fighting joined to fluid harassment. Their men were concentrated in the walled villages and ridge forts of eastern and southern Gansu, and returned to those villages to fight from them after each sortie; their horsemen cut the Qing grain roads, the relay stations and the columns of reinforcement, forcing the Chu army to detach troops to guard its supplies and preventing it from concentrating. When they stormed Xi'an and when they ringed Suzhou, the rebels used tunnels and buried powder to breach the walls; the siege of Suzhou lasted from 1864 for some twelve years, and the garrison held the ramparts on well water and on stored grain. The Qing kept to the Xiang method of advancing by successive entrenchments: dig a trench and raise a rampart every day and move forward a step at a time, with the guns firing bronze and light pieces in continuous bombardment at the stockade walls, and sappers working in close to blow them from underneath. Zuo Zongtang, once he arrived, put the transport of grain first and the advance second, moving grain to the front by camel train, mule train and the hide rafts of the Yellow River, and only then operating against Hezhou on several lines; it was the opening of the talks at Taoheying by Ma Wensheng in March 1877 that allowed the Qing to concentrate and take the fortified villages one by one. The Nian in Hebei, Henan and Shanxi kept drawing the Chu army away, and the Shaanxi-Gansu line was repeatedly stripped of troops, which was the most awkward feature of the court's position.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。時間線：一八六二年二月陝西華州起義，同年馬化龍在河州舉兵；一八六六年左宗棠授陝甘總督；一八六九年多隆阿總督陝甘；一八七〇年劉松山攻蒲城陣亡，同年十二月多隆阿陣亡於山西安邑曹店；一八七三年楊岳斌署陝甘總督；一八七六年十月清軍收復肅州，左宗棠移軍蘭州；一八七七年三月河州歸順，四月三十七名回軍首領被押至蘭州處決；一八七八年朝廷命左宗棠西征新疆。兵員：陝西起義初期集結的鄉勇與回民以萬計，肅州守軍為綠營與團練混編的數千人，左宗棠麾下楚軍主力數萬，軍需全靠內地籌運，奏報與糧臺簿冊記載的駱駝徵購以萬頭計，另有大量騾、牛與車。技術：一八六二年以鐵殼單獨交鋒而分勝負的著名戰例只有漢普頓斯維一役，英國鐵衛號等四艦同年入役；同年湘軍水師造成五艘輪船，即黃旗水師的起點。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. The sequence of dates: the rising at Huazhou in Shaanxi in February 1862 and Ma Hualong raising his banner at Hezhou in the same year; Zuo Zongtang made governor-general of Shaanxi-Gansu in 1866; Dolongga taking the same post in 1869; Liu Songshan killed at Pucheng in 1870 and Dolongga killed at Caodian in Anyi, Shanxi, in December of that year; Yang Yuebin signing for the governorship in 1873; Suzhou retaken by the Qing in October 1876 and Zuo Zongtang moving his headquarters to Lanzhou; Hezhou surrendering in March 1877 and thirty-seven leaders of the revolt being taken to Lanzhou and executed in April; and in 1878 the court ordering Zuo Zongtang on his western campaign. On the numbers of men: the village levies and Hui fighters mustered in Shaanxi at the start of the rising ran into the tens of thousands, the garrison of Suzhou was a mixed force of green standard troops and tuanlian numbering some thousands, and the main body of the Chu army under Zuo Zongtang counted tens of thousands more, with all supplies drawn from the interior provinces; the memorials and the transport ledgers record camels bought and impressed in numbers of thousands of head, together with a great many mules, oxen and carts. On technology: the only well known action fought between iron-armoured hulls alone was Hampton Roads in 1862, and the four British ironclads including HMS Warrior entered service in the same year; in that same year the Xiang navy completed five steamers, the beginning of the Yellow Flag fleet.
cause: 打起來的原因分政治、經濟、宗教三層。政治上，咸豐末年太平天國與捻軍擾亂，朝廷為守陝東，令回民集團編練鄉勇助剿；團練壯大之後，官府對回民練勇的戒心與岐視日深，加上清真寺被拆、鄉約被廢，矛盾積到一八六二年二月在華州、涇陽爆發。經濟上，軍需徵集把糧價推高，攤派與練勇餉項全落在鄉民身上，陝甘本就缺乏糧源。宗教上，河州一帶回民聚居稠密、教門組織完整，一次號召就能把鄉里網絡轉成軍隊。宏觀上，太平軍仍控制長江中游大部、捻軍席捲華北，清廷無法兩線兼顧，這正是回軍得以坐大的空隙；外間還傳言回軍與太平軍曾有間接聯絡，但兩者從未形成統一指揮。
causeEn: There were political, economic and religious layers behind the outbreak. Politically, the Taiping and the Nian disturbed the empire in the last years of the Xianfeng reign, and the court, to hold the eastern districts of Shaanxi, ordered the Hui communities to organise levies to help put the rebels down; once those levies had grown strong, official suspicion of and discrimination against the Hui armed men deepened, and with the demolition of mosques and the suppression of village compacts the friction came to a head in the rising at Huazhou and Jingyang in February 1862. Economically, the demands of the war drove grain prices up and the levies and the pay for the local levies fell entirely on the peasantry, in provinces that were already short of grain. Religiously, the Hui of the Hezhou area were densely settled and their religious organisation was complete, so a single call could turn the local network into an army. On the larger stage the Taiping still held much of the middle Yangtze and the Nian swept the north, and the court could not fight on both fronts, which was the opening that let the revolt in Shaanxi and Gansu grow; there were also reports of indirect contact between the rebels and the Taiping, though the two were never joined under a single command.
impact: 這場戰爭是同治朝三大內戰之一，影響主要落在軍制與地緣上。第一，朝廷為剿回軍在陝甘集中了湘軍楚勇、湖北與吉林馬隊、陝甘團練數路兵力，抽走了本該用於對付太平與捻軍的部隊，捻軍在華北得以坐大，到一八六八年才被平定。第二，戰後清廷把收編的回眾改編為甘軍，部分留鄉編入團練，部分調往寧夏、固原與青海，河州一帶自此形成以馬氏為核心的地方軍人勢力，晚清末年進而演成馬家軍割據甘肅的局面。第三，陝甘之亂讓新疆出現真空，浩罕頭目阿古柏乘機攻入新疆，俄羅斯於一八七一年進而佔領伊犁，這一連串變化最終把左宗棠推上西征之路，也把西北邊防的成本推給清廷的財政。第四，在技術層面，這是一場晚清裝備斷層的標本：前線主力仍靠抬槍與冷兵器，火砲稀少，攻城手段幾乎與明代無異；同年西方已進入鐵甲艦世代，差距一直靠一八七〇年代後的蘭州製造局與福州船政局慢慢補，卻已太遲。
impactEn: This war was one of the three great civil wars of the Tongzhi reign, and its consequences fell mainly on the military system and on geography. First, to put down the revolt the court concentrated in Shaanxi and Gansu the Chu and Xiang armies, the troops of Hubei and the Manchu cavalry of Jilin, and the local levies of the two provinces, pulling away the very forces that were needed against the Taiping and the Nian, which allowed the Nian to grow in the north until they were finally put down in 1868. Second, after the war the court turned the surrendered people into the Gansu army, some staying in their villages in the tuanlian and some being moved to Ningxia, Guyuan and Qinghai, and from that time a local military power centred on the Ma family grew up around Hezhou, which in the late Qing turned into the Ma family armies holding Gansu as a dependency. Third, the disorder in Shaanxi and Gansu left a vacuum in Xinjiang; Agub, the head of Kokand, marched in, and Russia took Ili in 1871, and that whole chain of events ended by putting Zuo Zongtang on the road west and by handing the cost of the northwestern frontier to the Qing treasury. Fourth, at the level of equipment this was a specimen of the late Qing's equipment gap: the front line still relied on shoulder guns and cold weapons, artillery was scarce, and the means of storming a wall were hardly different from the Ming; in the same year the West had entered the ironclad age, and the gap was only closed slowly after the 1870s by the Lanzhou arsenal and the Foochow shipyard, but by then it was too late.
result: 結果是清廷取勝而戰爭代價沉重。一八七六年十月清軍收復肅州，堡寨逐一歸順，回軍被壓回河州一線；一八七七年三月，馬文升開洮河營議降，河州各堡寨次第交出，清軍進占河州，隨即把馬文升、馬安良、馬中勳等三十七名首領押解蘭州處決，餘眾按戶編為回民團練，軍中骨幹拆散分插入營。朝廷封賞有功將領，左宗棠由此總攬西北軍務，陝甘兩省在名義上重歸一統。然而真正的收尾並不靠這場勝利：地方軍制與財政在十五年消耗後空虛，河州回軍骨幹轉化為地方勢力，晚清西北割據的隱患由此埋下；直到一八七八年左宗棠帶著同一批軍隊與同一套後勤西征新疆，收拾完西北另一場危機，這條線才算真正收束。
resultEn: The result was a Qing victory bought at a heavy price. In October 1876 the Qing retook Suzhou, the fortified villages came over one after another, and the rebels were pressed back to the line of Hezhou. In March 1877 Ma Wensheng opened the talks at Taoheying, the fortified villages of Hezhou were handed over in turn, the Qing entered Hezhou, and Ma Wensheng, Ma Anliang, Ma Zhongxun and the other leaders, thirty-seven of them, were taken under escort to Lanzhou and executed, while the remainder were enrolled as Hui militia by household and their military backbone was broken up and scattered among the units. The court rewarded the commanders who had deserved it, and Zuo Zongtang from then on held the northwest in his own hands, while Shaanxi and Gansu were once more nominally united under a single authority. Yet the real conclusion was not built on that victory. The local military system and the finances of the two provinces were hollow after fifteen years of consumption, and the backbone of the Hezhou revolt turned into a local power, so that the seeds of separatism in the late Qing northwest were sown there. The line was not truly closed until 1878, when Zuo Zongtang took the same troops and the same logistic system west into Xinjiang and saw the other crisis of the northwest settled.
